study type: Randomized controlled trial (APOSTEL III) combined with retrospective cohort study
cohort: 153 women with threatened preterm birth and ruptured membranes from the APOSTEL III trial (receiving tocolysis) and 51 women from the National Maternity Hospital, Dublin (no tocolysis), propensity score matched to create comparable groups (n=46 per group)
finding: In women with threatened preterm birth and ruptured membranes, tocolytic therapy did not significantly alter composite adverse neonatal outcome or time to delivery compared to no tocolysis.
mod_finding: While the study mentions mode of delivery as a secondary outcome, it does not report any findings related to mode of delivery between the tocolysis and no tocolysis groups.
